propositions: Best-effort tickets branch push failures that are expected and auto-healed surface WARNING-level messages to agent-visible stderr, priming LLM agents to assume corruption and investigate non-issues.

Mid-retry transient transport faults and contention-race terminal push failures emit INFO or above with raw git stderr and bare `..HEAD` references that escalate across concurrent sessions without stating the self-healing contract.
A non-zero or shared unpushed backlog count during normal concurrent-writer contention is flagged as a potential outage signal, wasting agent tokens, when it is routine noise.

Expected-case emissions must be demoted from INFO/WARNING to DEBUG, suppressed from agent-visible output, while policy declines, strict failures, and proven-growing backlogs remain operator-actionable WARNING/raise.
Backlog messages must name the tickets branch explicitly, state the self-healing contract in-text, and distinguish proven-growing backlog (escalate to WARNING) from routine contention (stay DEBUG).
Mid-retry transient notices at three sites (push_classify, push_recovery merge-leg, push_recovery fetch-leg) must be demoted to DEBUG with "retrying automatically, no action needed" wording.
